FPGA release: IP cores from all three major toolchains in your check.

**What's new**

- **Vivado (Xilinx/AMD)**: hardware handoffs (`*.hwh`) yield the complete
  IP inventory of a block design — including third-party cores — with
  concrete versions; `*.xci` files serve as fallback.
- **Libero (Microchip)**: component scripts are scanned, and generated
  project data (`.cxf`) resolves the `*` version wildcard to the actually
  built version. Unpinned cores are reported honestly, never guessed.
- **Quartus (Intel/Altera)**: `*_hw.tcl` IP definitions in your tree.

Every parser was verified against real public reference designs
(Digilent Zybo-Z7-20, Microchip Icicle Kit, ADI hdl).

As always: only component names, versions and ecosystems leave your
machine. Verify it yourself with `--dry-run`.
